unspoken etiquette rules that
make you quietly unforgettable

at the door
• greet everyone in the room
• let others go first
• take your coat off inside

at the table
• wait for the host to start
• pass to the right
• never stack plates

in conversation
• ask before you advise
• no phone, ever
• leave room for silence

as a guest
• bring something
• offer help once
• thank them the next day

always
• keep learning: art, history,
science, a little every day
